title: The Merchant???
move_pattern: Starts with Swipe. Then randomly cycles through Swipe, Spew Coins, Throw Relic, or Enrage (Enrage has 3x weight). After Throw Relic, switches to attack-only mode: Swipe, Spew Coins, or Throw Relic. Using Throw Relic from attack mode returns to full cycle.
notes: The Merchant has two distinct behavioral phases. Initially, it uses all four moves with a preference for Enrage. Once it uses Throw Relic, it enters a more focused attack pattern, limiting itself to pure damage and Frail application. Throw Relic returns it to the full move pool.
